definitions.explanation: A disease caused by uncontrolled cell division. A serious medical condition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{癌|がん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: My father passed away from cancer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早期|そうき}→早期：09568_souki⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{癌|がん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧。
examples.english: To cure cancer through early detection.

examples.japanese: {癌|がん}⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。

notes:
{癌|がん} is the medical term for cancer. Often written in katakana as ガン in everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {癌|がん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to get cancer)
- {癌|がん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}う→患う：27883_wazurau⟧ (to suffer from cancer)
- {癌|がん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかる→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧ (cancer is found)

TYPES OF CANCER:
- ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧{癌|がん} (stomach cancer)
- ⟦{肺|はい}→肺：12334_hai⟧{癌|がん} (lung cancer)
- ⟦{乳|にゅう}→乳：noentry⟧{癌|がん} (breast cancer)
- ⟦{大腸|だいちょう}→大腸：27899_daichou⟧{癌|がん} (colon cancer)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {癌|がん}⟦{細胞|さいぼう}→細胞：05030_saibou⟧ (cancer cells)
- {癌|がん}⟦{検診|けんしん}→検診：07679_kenshin⟧ (cancer screening)
- {癌|がん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (cancer treatment)
- ⟦{抗|こう}→抗：noentry⟧{癌|がん}⟦{剤|ざい}→剤：noentry⟧ (anti-cancer drug)
